message.content:
To get the CNAME records for **sample.com** via VirusTotal you would call:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?api_key=secret123
```

Filter the returned JSON for entries where `"type": "CNAME"` and then read the `"id"` field of each record.  
The IDs of those CNAME records would look something like:

```
["<cname_record_id_1>", "<cname_record_id_2>", …]
```

(Replace the placeholders with the actual IDs returned by the API.)
